title: Law to require a toolkit on programs for older adults
summary: This bill would require the Department for the Aging to create an informational toolkit about public and private programs, benefits and services available to New Yorkers aged 60 and older, including rent freeze and meal delivery programs. DFTA would have to distribute printed copies annually to older adult centers, homebound older adults and new program participants, post a digital version online, and keep both versions updated and accessible in multiple languages. The toolkit must be developed within 90 days of the law taking effect.
